rationale: Setup at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC is the only binding limit; hold (+0.08 ns, no buffers), slew/cap (0 vs bar 89) and DRC (0) have headroom. With cap213, signoff slack lands 0.12-0.15 ns above the setup margin (0.18->0.30, 0.2->0.33, 0.4->0.54): repair converges, and period (0.45) and margins (0.4) are at their limits, so only physical changes remain. The util-38 die let a port path bind while reg-to-reg was unchanged, so keep the util-30 die. Setting 1: best run with slew/cap repair targets at 40% (free under the bar) for sharper transitions at the slow corner. Setting 2: best run with denser placement (46%) in the same die, cutting wire length and the ~6% routing detour.
